labels.text: The patient's limiting physiology selects the hypnotic
Fast hypnosis and recovery can cost pressure and ventilation.
Relative hemodynamic stability trades against myoclonus and adrenal suppression.
Often stimulating, but not immune to apnea, emergence, or catecholamine-depleted collapse.
Treat the trajectory before temperature becomes the headline
Early hypercapnia, tachycardia, acidosis, and muscle rigidity define the pattern.
Stop volatile agents and succinylcholine, then give repeated actual-weight dantrolene.
Cool, correct potassium and acidosis, protect kidneys, and monitor recurrence.
